fields.statement: At ab36a226 (leaf commits 2438d674 and fix ab36a226), go test -trimpath -count=1 ./internal/changeset/... ./internal/entry/... ./internal/render/... passes. TestOpenRef round-trips an open with a ref (v4, decoded and canonical), checks that no ref leaves the encoding without a ref key at EntryVersion 1, rejects a 2049-byte ref while accepting 2048, and refuses the ref field at v1-v3. TestCorpusFolds, TestPropertyPermutation and render TestGolden pass on the new format-4/ref corpus case. go test -trimpath ./cmd/rhiza -run 'TestScripts/(change-set-ref|describe-golden)$' passes. The script checks that change new --ref, then change show --json and change show, print the ref. The human line is Go-quoted (\x1b and \n escaped, no raw ESC byte). The ref is trimmed and a blank one means none. An over-limit ref is a usage error that writes nothing, and fold-ok holds. Diff read: Ref is encoded only when set, decodeBody accepts it only at v>=4, and FormatVersion is now 4.
